<DOCSTRING>
Backtracks through potential matches to determine if the input string matches the pattern.

Args:
    pattern_index (int): The current index in the pattern being matched. Must be non-negative and less than the length of the pattern.
    str_index (int): The current index in the input string being matched. Must be non-negative and less than the length of the input string.

Returns:
    bool: True if the input string matches the pattern up to the current indices, False otherwise.
</DOCSTRING>
